Definition: The middle value once the runs are ordered: half fall below it, half above. Reported as the headline for error because it is insensitive to outliers -- a single divergent series shifts a mean without limit but moves a median by at most one rank position.
The arithmetic average. Reported alongside the median so the gap between the two is visible: a mean far above its median indicates a right-skewed error distribution driven by a few large failures.
Standard deviation divided by the mean, expressed as a percentage. A scale-free measure of dispersion, so series of different volumes are comparable.
Median of APE over runs classed ok. The headline correctness figure.
